keyword: electric low pressure 40 fine stone pump

title.en: Does the low-pressure Electric 40 fit a fine-stone building?
title.zh: 电动低压40适合细石建筑浇筑吗？

description.en: Yes for the printed fine-stone window: 37 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, horizontal 80 m / vertical 240 m, 1200 kg. The page does not print an aggregate-13 distance.
description.zh: 可以，只要落在已印细石窗口：37 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、水平 80 m / 垂直 240 m、1200 kg。该页没有 13 骨料距离。

h1.en: Does the low-pressure Electric 40 fit a fine-stone building?
h1.zh: 电动低压40适合细石建筑浇筑吗？

directAnswer.en: Yes, when the pour is the fine-stone line Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints for the Electric Low Pressure 40 in Xingtai: 37 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, hopper 0.3 m³, horizontal 80 m / vertical 240 m, Kawasaki 112 hydraulic pump, 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and 1200 kg. The scenario line is building and commercial placement. There is no aggregate-13 distance on this page.
directAnswer.zh: 可以，只要浇筑对得上邢台河北品锦机械为电动低压40印的细石行：37 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、料斗 0.3 m³、水平 80 m / 垂直 240 m、川崎 112 液压泵、外形 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm、1200 kg。工况句是建筑与商业浇筑。这一页没有 13 骨料距离。

heading.en: How is this different from Electric 30?

body.en: Both print 12–15 m³/h and 20 MPa. Electric 30’s fine-stone pair is 60 m / 180 m and it also prints aggregate 13 at 20 m / 60 m on a 30 kW motor. The low-pressure 40 fine-stone pair is 80 m / 240 m on a 37 kW motor, and the aggregate-13 row is absent. Do not copy Electric 30’s second row onto this machine.
body.zh: 两台都印 12–15 m³/h 和 20 MPa。电动30细石是 60 m / 180 m，并且在 30 kW 电机上另有 13 骨料 20 m / 60 m。低压40的细石是 80 m / 240 m、电机 37 kW，没有 13 骨料行。不要把电动30的第二行抄到这台机器上。

heading.en: How is this different from the standard Electric 40?

body.en: The standard Electric 40 is the medium-building row in the selection guide: 45 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, fine stone 120 m / 360 m, aggregate 13 at 40 m / 120 m, and 2300 kg. The low-pressure 40 stays at 12–15 m³/h and 1200 kg. Same “40” in the name is not the same table.
body.zh: 标准电动40是选型指南里的中型建筑行：45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、细石 120 m / 360 m、13 骨料 40 m / 120 m、2300 kg。低压40停在 12–15 m³/h 和 1200 kg。名字里都有“40”，表并不同。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Confirm the mix is fine stone. If you only know a 13 mm or 2 cm label, say so and do not assume this page covers it. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请确认料是细石。如果只有 13 mm 或 2 cm 的标注，请写明，不要默认这一页覆盖它。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: Does this model print maximum aggregate?
question.zh: 这个型号印了最大骨料吗？

answer.en: The specification list used here does not include a maximum-aggregate cell. Do not borrow ≤ 3 cm from Electric 30.
answer.zh: 这里采用的规格表没有最大骨料格。不要向电动30借用 ≤ 3 cm。

answer.en: No. The fine-stone cell is horizontal 80 m / vertical 240 m.
answer.zh: 不是。细石格是水平 80 m / 垂直 240 m。

question.en: Is the Kawasaki 112 cell a reason to pick this pump?
question.zh: 川崎 112 这一格能单独作为选型理由吗？

answer.en: It is a printed component cell. The application match is still the fine-stone distance, output and a supply for 37 kW.
answer.zh: 它是已印的部件格。工况对照仍然是细石距离、输送量和能否供应 37 kW。
